definition: יְהוֺעַדָּה proper name, masculine (meaning dubious; Thes ׳ י hath adorned (as Hebrew עדה Hiph`il; verb of Pa`el form); MV ׳ י is equipment , compare Arabic ; possibly ׳ י hath carried off spoil , or hath deposed ( ᵑ7 עדא Pe`al, Pa`el, Aph`el; compare Haph`el Dan 2:21 ); or perhaps ׳ י hath numbered Arabic ) — a descendant of Saul 1Chr 8:36 (twice in verse) ( ᵐ5 Ἰωαδα , A Ἰωιαδα , ᵐ5 L Ἰωδα ) = יַעְרָה 1Chr 9:42 (twice in verse) (for יֹעַדָּה ? compare Be. ᵐ5 Ἰαδα , ᵐ5 L Ἰωδα .

יְהוֺעַדָּה proper name, masculine (meaning dubious; Thes ׳י hath adorned (as Hebrew עדה Hiph`il; verb of Pa`el form); MV ׳י is equipment, compare Arabic ; possibly ׳י hath carried off spoil, or hath deposed (ᵑ7 עדא Pe`al, Pa`el, Aph`el; compare Haph`el Dan 2:21); or perhaps ׳י hath numbered Arabic ) — a descendant of Saul 1Chr 8:36 (twice in verse) (ᵐ5 Ἰωαδα, A Ἰωιαδα, ᵐ5L Ἰωδα) = יַעְרָה 1Chr 9:42 (twice in verse) (for יֹעַדָּה ? compare Be. ᵐ5 Ἰαδα, ᵐ5L Ἰωδα.
